name: Line Profile FWHM Measurement
description:
Perform a quantitative Full Width at Half Maximum (FWHM) analysis on cell nuclei.

1. Open the built-in 'Fluorescent Cells' sample image in Fiji (File > Open Samples > Fluorescent Cells).
2. Split the channels (Image > Color > Split Channels) and select the blue (DAPI) channel showing nuclei.
3. For at least 5 distinct nuclei:
   - Draw a straight line across the center of the nucleus using the Straight Line tool.
   - Generate an intensity profile (Analyze > Plot Profile or 'k' key).
   - Measure the Full Width at Half Maximum (FWHM) of the intensity peak in pixels.
   - Record the Nucleus ID, Peak Intensity, Background Intensity, and FWHM.

4. Save the measurements to a CSV file at: ~/ImageJ_Data/results/fwhm_measurements.csv

The CSV must contain columns for 'Nucleus', 'Peak_Intensity', 'Background_Intensity', 'FWHM_pixels', and 'Line_Length_pixels'. Include a summary row at the bottom with the Mean and Standard Deviation of the FWHM values.
